title: Improved bounds for the double cap conjecture
summary: In 1974, Witsenhausen asked for the maximum possible density $α_n$ of a measurable subset $A$ of the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^{n-1}\subset \mathbb{R}^n$ such that $A$ contains no pair of orthogonal vectors. For $n=3$, the best known lower bound is $1 - 1/\sqrt{2} = 0.29289\dots$, obtained from the natural "double cap" construction of two opposite spherical caps, which is conjectured to be optimal for all $n$ by Gil Kalai.
